summary: Join our comprehensive training on Health and Safety Regulations in the Construction Industry. Equip yourself with essential knowledge for a safer workplace.
lede: Health and safety regulations in the construction industry provide a practical framework for protecting workers and the public while keeping projects compliant and responsibly managed. This course helps you interpret key regulations, turn them into clear site rules and procedures, and apply them confidently in daily construction management. Through hands-on, scenario-driven learning, you will learn to identify hazards, assess risk, control unsafe conditions, and respond appropriately when incidents occur. You will build the confidence to enforce safety standards, support audit readiness, and help prevent delays, fines, and reputational damage.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage or influence health and safety on construction projects. Whether you are on the front lines or behind the scenes, your role in ensuring safety compliance is vital.
audience: Health and safety officers and EHS coordinators
modules: Foundations of Health and Safety in Construction
Legal and Regulatory Framework for Construction Safety
Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment on Construction Sites
Safe Systems of Work, Method Statements, and Permits
Working at Height, Lifting Operations, and Equipment Safety
Excavation, Confined Spaces, and High-Risk Site Conditions
Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), Health Risks, and Welfare
Incident Reporting, Investigation, and Regulatory Interaction
Contractor Management, Training, and Continuous Improvement
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of construction processes and a foundational awareness of health and safety principles. Prior experience in managing or supervising construction projects is beneficial.
